company.name: Foundation Medicine
company.shortDescription: Foundation medicine is a molecular information company developing clinical diagnostic tests that facilitates personalized cancer therapies.
company.description: Foundation Medicine plans to create clinical diagnostic tests that can use the latest in genetic sequencing technology to identify personalized cancer therapies for patients.

productsAndServices.description: An FDA-approved tissue-based comprehensive genomic profiling test for solid tumors that analyzes 324 genes and reports biomarkers relevant to targeted therapies, companion diagnostics, and clinical trials.
productsAndServices.name: FoundationOne®CDx

productsAndServices.description: An FDA-approved blood-based comprehensive genomic profiling test that analyzes 324 genes from circulating cell-free DNA to support therapy selection, companion diagnostics, and clinical-trial matching.
productsAndServices.name: FoundationOne®Liquid CDx

productsAndServices.description: A laboratory-developed comprehensive genomic profiling test for hematologic malignancies that combines DNA and RNA sequencing to identify mutations, copy-number changes, fusions, and other alterations.
productsAndServices.name: FoundationOne®Heme

productsAndServices.description: A laboratory-developed RNA sequencing test that analyzes 318 cancer-associated genes to detect gene fusions and complex rearrangements relevant to therapy selection in solid tumors.
productsAndServices.name: FoundationOne®RNA

productsAndServices.description: A tumor-informed molecular residual disease assay for stage II–III breast cancer that uses structural-variant tracking and digital PCR to detect ctDNA and monitor recurrence.
productsAndServices.name: FoundationOne®MRD

productsAndServices.description: Pathologist-led immunohistochemistry testing for tissue biopsies that measures protein expression markers to complement genomic profiling and inform treatment selection and trial enrollment.
productsAndServices.name: IHC Testing

aiResearchSummary.text: Foundation Medicine is advancing methods for tumor profiling and personalized cancer therapies. They focus on categorizing tumor profiling results by evidence levels, detecting tumor-derived viral reads, and predicting HER2 activity for anti-HER2 ADC treatment. Their research includes prognostic classification using genetic markers and analyzing methylation status of ctDNA to predict cancer cell expression. These efforts aim to enhance precision in cancer diagnostics and treatment personalization.
